component.name: Vortex
component.summary: Install and run Windows games on Linux through Proton

description.p: Vortex is a native GTK and libadwaita launcher that is being built to install and run Windows games on Linux through Proton, using UMU Launcher (umu-run). Each game gets its own isolated Wine prefix.

Vortex is an early MVP. It has a game library, an install wizard for installer files and folders, per-game configuration, backup and restore, and log viewing. Its end-to-end verification status is tracked in the project repository.
